name: sunny-g1-entry-readiness-g0
decision_rule: Any open G1 entry blocker means NO_GO. Independently reviewed numeric and experiment approvals are required before G1 begins; 37 G1 cases are expected not_run at entry. G1 completion requires measured Windows outcomes for all 37. The 13 G2 cases cannot be discharged by G1.

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: reviewed disposable loopback server/client and manual rollback design, explicit endpoint/process inventory including a second disposable port only if approved, otherwise offline mismatch fixture
gates.reason_open: isolated build identity, approved endpoint inventory and teardown method have not been reviewed; observed teardown belongs to G1

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: source-backed observation plan for original request-target, Host, duplicate headers, peer and kernel-vs-handler behavior
gates.reason_open: no reviewed source-backed feasibility and fallback plan for measuring raw-field fidelity; Windows proof belongs to G1

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: reviewed strategy to observe or enforce first-byte/connection timing before GetContextAsync and account for HTTP.sys queueing
gates.reason_open: no trustworthy first-byte anchor or enforceable equivalent has been selected

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: explicitly bounded headers, pending connections and HTTP.sys queue without unapproved machine-wide configuration
gates.reason_open: pre-auth and kernel queue occupancy are unbounded by the offline post-handler ledger

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: reviewed request-vs-listener abort method, bounded collateral shutdown and independent operator stop outside the saturated listener; no claim while reads remain pending
gates.reason_open: abort operation, scope and independent bounded stop method have not been reviewed; effectiveness is measured during G1

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: reviewed observation plan for read completion, buffer quarantine, late callbacks and bounded teardown; latched halt, manual rollback and no automatic restart
gates.reason_open: no reviewed ownership and teardown measurement method; actual task/buffer completion evidence belongs to G1

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: independent experiment-only approval of finite total/header/body/cleanup/response-write time, byte sizes, pre-auth connections, concurrency and backlog bounds before bind
gates.reason_open: Phase 2G numeric candidates are not ratified

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: vetted raw-byte fixture catalog that distinguishes permitted good requests, malformed inputs and safe response behavior
gates.reason_open: fixture source, caps, rate and expected per-probe evidence are not yet approved

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: explicit new user/operator approval of exact build, disposable endpoint/process inventory, fixtures, finite traffic and duration caps, independent stop owner and manual rollback
gates.reason_open: this G0 PR is not permission to open an endpoint or change Windows

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: reviewed evidence scrub policy, no P1/user diary/game/token material, no automatic OS edits, no side-effects
gates.reason_open: G1 trace collection and data minimization controls have not been approved

gates.required_reviewed_artifact: reviewed per-case GO/FAIL/BLOCK thresholds for 37 G1 entries, kernel-vs-handler denial, unknown/fail, and rollback
gates.reason_open: G1 evidence ledger and acceptance-owner review process remain proposed

non_entry_separate_future_work: G1 completion: run only explicitly approved isolated Windows transport cases and independently review observed evidence
G2: protect every route, issue/revoke real credentials, atomic P2 lease/epoch and game-step admission, durable retirement and outcome journaling
G2: P1 consent-safe projection, native Luna/P12 migration, Windows/SMAPI freeze and gameplay acceptance
